judgment.rationale: Reporter gives a startup reproduction and says disabling PowerToys Run removes the flash. A temporary startup surface is plausible but not confirmed by the screenshots.
evidence: PowerToys 0.80.1 launched from Start; Run enabled.
Flash disappears with Run disabled and appears with it enabled; screenshots of rectangle and modules attached.
No comments; live OPEN, Issue-Bug / Product-PowerToys Run / Area-Quality / Priority-3, unassigned.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce both module states and correlate the flash with window creation/show events.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix or owner; the A/B comparison localizes likely subsystem but not the surface.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent a transient PowerToys Run startup surface
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Run may create or show its launcher/host surface during initialization before its hidden state is applied, exposing a rectangle for a frame.
plan: Cold-start PowerToys with Run on/off and correlate the visible flash with Run window events.
Trace startup/activation and identify any first presentation before hidden state is set.
Apply visibility state before presentation or defer creation until Run is invoked.
Add startup UI verification that detects an unintended visible surface.
verification: Capture cold startup with Run enabled and disabled; confirm no flash.
Invoke Run afterwards and verify normal launcher behavior.

confidence.rationale: The A/B comparison localizes Run, but no event trace identifies a window versus another rendered startup artifact.

issue_context.summary: A rectangle briefly flashes on desktop during PowerToys startup; reporter says it happens with PowerToys Run enabled and not when disabled.
known_information: PowerToys 0.80.1, launch from Windows Start, PowerToys Run enabled.
Reporter tested Run on/off and attached screenshots of flash and enabled modules.
No comments; live OPEN, Issue-Bug / Product-PowerToys Run, unassigned.
inferences: Run may present a startup surface before hidden state is established, but its identity is unverified.
issue_context.analysis: The module on/off comparison supports maintainer-side reproduction and window-event correlation rather than generic reporter logs.

reproduce.title: Compare startup with PowerToys Run enabled/disabled
reproduce.version_requirement: Current development build; compare 0.80.1 if available
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 with PowerToys launchable from Start
PowerToys Run can be enabled and disabled
setup: Use cold launch and capture desktop before invoking Run.
steps: Enable Run, fully exit PowerToys, launch from Start, and watch startup before invoking Run.
Repeat with Run disabled and other settings unchanged.
If visible, correlate flash time with Run window creation/show events.
Invoke Run after startup to confirm normal behavior.
reproduce.expected_result: No unintended rectangle appears during startup; launcher appears only when explicitly invoked.
